jobs.title: Senior Program Manager, Microwave
jobs.description:
About the role

Muon seeks a Senior Program Manager - Microwave to lead Muon Space’s Microwave Program efforts, responsible for successfully delivering solutions, products, and technology while managing cost and schedule baselines with the U.S. Government and Commercial Organizations. The Program Manager will be a key member of the Mission Engineering team and collaborate closely with Muon Space’s engineering, business, legal, finance, and operations departments. You will also support the portfolio's growth by fostering organic growth on existing contracts and supporting captures of new contracts.

As a Technical Program Manager at Muon Space, you delight our customers and users with high-quality products and solutions delivered on time and on budget, meeting our contractual obligations. You are cognizant of how all the pieces need to come together for successful program execution and can turn that into well-organized roadmaps, schedules, and budgets that you then track throughout the program lifecycle. You will be responsible for monitoring and ensuring successful execution of Muon’s contracts that you manage. You will support business development through proposals, RFI responses, customer engagement, and organic growth.

This role is based in San Jose with a hybrid schedule (3 days per week in-office), but may be worked remotely from an approved location.

Responsibilities

- Lead a multidisciplinary aerospace development effort, driving day-to-day execution of the program

- Engage with internal and external stakeholders to plan and coordinate the resources necessary to execute the program

- Synchronize a diverse technical team by establishing tools, practices, and process

- Participate in technical discussions, ask probing questions, and work with the team to pull together scoping, schedules, and solutions to issues

- Track and report program metrics on schedule, resource, cost, risk, and technical performance

- Serve as the face of the company to customers, subcontractors and suppliers

Qualifications

- 5+ years relevant experience in program management

- B.S. in an engineering discipline, M.S. or Ph.D. preferred

- Track record of successfully delivering complete systems (hardware, firmware, software, algorithms) on time, to scope, with high quality.

- Experience in development and/or program management of satellite based systems. Ability to instantiate and manage integrated master schedules.

- Expertise in modern, cloud-based productivity tools

- Excellent analytical and interpersonal skills, with ability to work successfully across all engineering disciplines.

- Experience in vendor and contract management

Nice-to-have Skills

- System engineering and experience with inter-discipline technical trade study

- Experience in a fast-paced, startup environment

- Experience managing and growing teams

- Experience with microwave instruments

Salary

The salary range for this role is $155,000 - $220,000, plus a competitive equity grant and comprehensive benefits package. Final compensation will be determined based on skills, qualifications, experience, and geographic location as assessed during the interview process.
About Muon Space

Founded in 2021, Muon Space is an end-to-end Space Systems Provider that designs, builds, and operates LEO satellite constellations delivering mission-critical data. Our revolutionary, integrated technology stack enables customers to optimize every dimension of their missions for faster time-to-orbit and superior constellation remote sensing performance. Our state-of-the-art facility in the heart of Silicon Valley is optimized for manufacturing spacecraft and rapid, flexible payload integration at scale. From climate monitoring to national security, Muon Space is dedicated to delivering Earth Intelligence for a safer and more resilient world.

Taking Care of Our Team

At Muon salary is only part of our total compensation package. In addition to salary, full-time employees receive equity compensation as well as benefits including medical, dental, and vision insurance, a 401k retirement plan, short & long term disability and life insurance. We also offer three weeks paid vacation for new employees, along with 12 paid holidays, unlimited sick time and paid parental leave.

Our mission embraces the entire planet and we believe our team should too.  Muon is dedicated to creating a diverse and dynamic company and workforce. We believe in equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, age, national origin, citizenship, sexual orientation, marital status, disability, or gender identity. We value diversity in the workplace, and that starts with our applicants. We encourage you to apply, even if you don't check all the boxes, and we look forward to reviewing your application! In addition, if you need a reasonable accommodation as part of your application for employment or interviews with us, please let us know.

jobs.title: Senior Program Manager, Missile Warning & Tracking
jobs.description:
About the role

Muon Space seeks a Senior Program Manager to lead delivery of next-generation satellites for national security missions, including missile warning and tracking. This is a high-visibility, high-impact role at the intersection of payload engineering and rapid-cycle space vehicle development.

The Senior PM is the accountable owner for delivering the program on cost, schedule, and technical performance. You will manage a multi-disciplinary internal team, subcontractors, and a critical-path vendor base for EO/IR payloads, algorithm development, avionics, and space vehicle builds. The role spans the full program lifecycle: design reviews, hardware build, integration and environmental test, launch, and on-orbit operations.

This position is hybrid and requires working on-site in our San Jose, CA office three days per week.

Responsibilities

- Program Execution

- Own the integrated master schedule, cost baseline, and risk register

- Drive the program through preliminary and critical design reviews, payload and spacecraft integration, environmental test, launch, and on-orbit demonstration, meeting customer milestones and contract deliverables

- Manage scope, cost, and period of performance against contract milestones and payment events

- Lead day-to-day execution of the program team to the contract, running the weekly program cadence, internal design reviews, and readiness reviews; provide status and briefing content to the Mission Manager, who is the customer interface

- Own the preparation and quality of contract deliverables, including status reports, design review packages, technical and cost data, test plans, and final reports, for delivery to the customer

- Partner with the Mission Manager and Muon's Capture and Business Development teams on follow-on strategy

- Subcontractor and Vendor Management

- Manage program subcontracts, including mission data processing and algorithm development

- Coordinate critical-path vendors for detectors, focal plane arrays, cooler assemblies, and optics across long-lead procurements

- Keep subcontract scope, cost, and schedule aligned with prime contract commitments

- Technical Leadership and Risk Management

- Partner closely with the lead systems engineer and technical leads (payload design, AI&T, optics, electronics, software, mechanisms, thermal, mission systems) to drive technical decisions

- Own and actively work the program risk register, including supply chain, integration, launch, and demonstration risks

- Resolve cross-functional issues quickly and escalate to functional and program leadership when needed

- Compliance and Reporting

- Ensure program execution complies with contract requirements, including U.S.-only performance, ITAR/EAR export controls, technical data rights, security requirements, and CUI handling

- Coordinate with Contracts and Finance on subcontract changes, invoicing, and program financial reporting

Required Qualifications

- 8+ years of professional experience in program or technical management of complex technical system development, deployment, and operations

- 5+ years of hands-on technical experience, preferably in an engineering or similar capacity, or direct ownership of a hardware development effort through design reviews to a tested product

- Direct experience with space, defense, or aerospace program planning and execution

- Demonstrated experience managing programs with multiple subcontractors and a complex critical-path supply chain

- Experience executing rapid-acquisition or prototype agreements for government customers, with familiarity navigating the government program lifecycle, technical data rights, and contract deliverables

- Active Secret U.S. security clearance

- U.S. citizenship required (Clearance required and program is ITAR-restricted)

- Excellent written communication skills; you will author or approve the program's contract deliverables

Preferred Qualifications

- Active Top Secret or TS/SCI clearance

- Prior experience on a missile warning, missile tracking, missile defense, or similar space-based infrared program

- Working knowledge of EO/IR sensor architectures, focal plane arrays, and cryocooler integration

- Working knowledge of missile warning data products and techniques for detection and tracking

- Experience managing programs through environmental test campaigns (TVAC, vibration, EMI/EMC)

- Experience with launch integration and early on-orbit operations

Salary

The salary range for this role is  $206,000 - $232,000, plus a competitive equity grant and comprehensive benefits package. Final compensation will be determined based on skills, qualifications, experience, and geographic location as assessed during the interview process.

jobs.title: Senior Program Manager, Secure Space Data Systems
jobs.description:
About the role

Muon Space seeks a Senior Program Manager to lead the development, demonstration, and productization of secure data-handling capabilities for our satellite platforms. This work directly expands the set of national-security missions Muon can pursue and execute — the Program Manager owns both the program's execution and its transition into active proposals and funded flight programs.

This is a hands-on role at the intersection of hardware development, embedded firmware, security engineering, and government mission capture. It is a technical program management position: the right candidate contributes directly to the engineering — architecture, design, analysis, and test — as a working member of the team, not just its coordinator. The Program Manager is the single accountable owner for cost, schedule, and technical performance across the program's parallel swimlanes: cryptographic hardware carrier development, hardware-in-the-loop (HITL) testbed build-out, end-to-end encrypted data-path demonstration (ground-to-flight and flight-to-ground), and proposal-ready design artifacts for upcoming government opportunities. Because the team is small and senior, the PM does their own scheduling, cost tracking, and program control — there is no supporting program office.

This position is hybrid and requires working on-site in our San Jose, CA office three days per week.

Responsibilities

- Program Execution

- Own the integrated master schedule, cost baseline, and risk register for the program

- Drive the program through design reviews, hardware build and integration, test campaigns, and demonstration milestones — meeting all internal and customer commitments

- Run the weekly program cadence; make decisions with incomplete information at startup pace and escalate crisply when needed

- Security and Compliance

- Own the program's security and compliance posture, including controlled-material handling and coordination with government security processes and certification requirements

- Ensure all execution complies with ITAR/EAR export controls and U.S.-only performance requirements

- Technical Contribution and Cross-Functional Leadership

- Contribute directly to the engineering and design of the system — architecture and trade studies, requirements development, design analysis, and hands-on support of integration and test

- Partner closely with the Mission Manager, Chief Engineer, and cross-disciplinary technical leads to drive technical decision-making

- Own configuration control and drive resolution of cross-functional issues quickly, escalating to program leadership when needed

- Capture and Proposal Support

- Support active proposal and capture efforts with technical artifacts and cost and schedule inputs, without derailing baseline execution

- Partner with Business Development, Capture, and Product teams on transitioning the capability into funded flight programs

- Represent the program in customer and partner technical exchanges

Required Qualifications

- 6+ years of professional experience in program management of complex technical system development spanning hardware and software

- 5+ years of hands-on engineering experience (electrical, embedded systems, mechanical, RF/communications, or similar), with the ability and desire to contribute directly to design, analysis, and test while leading the program

- Direct experience with space, defense, or aerospace programs that handle CUI or classified data

- Demonstrated ownership of a board- or box-level hardware development effort through design reviews to a working, tested product

- Experience leading testbed, HITL, or ground-segment development and running structured verification or demonstration campaigns

- Working understanding of secure communications concepts — Type 1 encryption, Red/Black separation, key management — and their program-level implications (certification timelines, custody requirements, cleared-personnel constraints)

- Ability to obtain and maintain a U.S. Top Secret clearance

- U.S. Citizenship required (program is ITAR-restricted)

- Excellent written communication skills — you will author or approve design review packages, test plans and results, and customer-facing technical artifacts

Preferred Qualifications

- Active Secret or TS/SCI clearance

- Prior experience integrating NSA Type 1 cryptographic units (e.g., HAIPE-class devices) or managing COMSEC/CCI on a flight program

- Direct experience working with SDA, NRO, USSF Space Systems Command, or similar customer offices

- Familiarity with embedded firmware and FPGA development lifecycles — board bring-up, driver development, DITL testing

- Experience running IR&D or capability-development programs whose artifacts feed concurrent proposals and captures

- Experience supporting classified proposal development and color-team reviews

- PMP certification or equivalent program management credentials

Salary

The salary range for this role is $206,000 - $232,000 , plus a competitive equity grant and comprehensive benefits package. Final compensation will be determined based on skills, qualifications, experience, and geographic location as assessed during the interview process.

jobs.description:

The Director of Business Development reports to the Senior Vice President of Growth and collaborates closely with Muon Space’s Engineering, Technology, legal and finance departments. You will be responsible for outreach to the IC customer community as well as strategic planning for that portfolio. You will actively contribute to Muon Space’s internal development, setting priorities and service as a voice for the customer. You will service as a capture manager to create and lead a number of new opportunities.

As a Director of Business Development (BD) working in the portfolio focused on IC, you will be responsible for creating new opportunities, leading capture activities, proposals and successfully winning new business. In this role, you will lead and perform key functions necessary to go from initial customer engagement/ lead to fully awarded contracts.

This position must be performed within the Northern Virginia region.

- Drive near term and long term growth for Muon Space in IC.

- Lead customer engagement, pipeline development and capture efforts.

- 10+ years of professional experience in aerospace/ defense with 5+ years in Business Development.

- Demonstrated success capturing space business within the IC.

- Continuous learner that is not afraid to lead through uncertainty, take chances, and learn from his/her mistakes.

- Consistently takes initiative and champions causes that need to be addressed.

- Demonstrated emotional intelligence to interact and empathize with staff, colleagues, cross-functional teams, and customers.

- Comfortable working in a dynamic and fast-paced development environment.

jobs.title: Director of Growth Operations
jobs.description:
About this Role

Muon Space is looking for a Director of Growth Operations to build and lead the operational backbone of our Growth organization. This role owns and scales the teams and processes that support Muon's business development and capture activities: Partner Management, Proposal Management, Technical Writing, BD Analytics & Research, and Pricing. You will report to the Senior Vice President of Growth and work closely with Business Development, Mission Architecture, Mission Innovation, Marketing, Engineering, Finance, Contracts, and Legal.

As Director of Growth Operations, you will be responsible for enabling Business Development and Capture Activities leading to achievement of Growth Targets, This is a player-coach role: you will manage and develop a multidisciplinary team while also rolling up your sleeves on high-priority activities, and you develop the team and processes to enable repeatable, scalable operations.

This position must be performed within the Northern Virginia or San Jose region.

Key Responsibilities

-  Lead and manage a multidisciplinary team spanning Partner Management, Proposal Management, Technical Writing, BD Analytics & Research, and Pricing.

-  Own end-to-end proposal operations — schedules, compliance, resourcing, and quality across multiple concurrent pursuits, in partnership with capture and proposal leads.

-  Lead the Partner Management function: identify, qualify, and manage strategic partnerships and teaming agreements that strengthen Muon's competitive position.

- Oversee the Pricing function during its initial stand-up, including price-to-win development, with a plan to transition or scale the function as the org grows.

- Build and mature the BD Analytics & Research capability, including market intelligence, competitive analysis, and pipeline reporting to inform capture and growth strategy.

-  Direct the Proposal Management and Technical Writing function to ensure consistent, high-quality, compliant proposal and capture content.

-  Design and implement scalable systems, tools, and playbooks CRM hygiene and reporting, proposal templates, knowledge management, and reusable content libraries.

-  Partner cross-functionally with BD, Mission Architecture, Mission Innovation, Engineering, Finance, Contracts, and Legal to keep operations aligned with pursuit and delivery needs.

- Establish metrics and reporting to track team performance, proposal win rates, and operational throughput for the SVP of Growth.

- Mentor, develop, and grow direct reports as the Growth organization scales.

- All other duties as assigned.

Basic Qualifications

- 10+ years of experience in business operations, proposal management, or related business development support functions, ideally within aerospace, defense, or the space industry.

-  Demonstrated experience building and managing multidisciplinary teams.

- Experience with pricing or price-to-win processes and cross-functional coordination with Finance.

- Strong process-design and program management skills, with a track record of scaling operations in a fast-growing organization.

- Excellent written and verbal communication skills.

- Able to manage multiple concurrent priorities and competing deadlines in a dynamic, fast-paced environment.

Desired Qualifications

- Experience in the space or satellite industry.

- Experience managing partners or teaming relationships in a capture or BD context.

- Experience with CRM and proposal management tools (e.g., HubSpot).

- Active or recent U.S. Government security clearance.

- Master's degree in a related field.

jobs.title: International Business Development Intern (Summer 2027)
jobs.description:
About the role

Summer internships will range between the months of May and September depending on university schedules. Internship is full-time and on-site in Washington, DC.

The Growth team at Muon is responsible for expanding Muon’s customer base to international defence and civil agencies with satellite constellations. Interns can look forward to owning a project from start to finish which could involve conducting market research, competitive analysis, budget research, recommending potential in-country partnerships for a specified country, and mapping out customer engagement with key in-country leadership.  Come work with the team and help us expand into the international market!

Muon is a small and fast growing startup which offers interns the experience to get direct mentorship and have real impact on our programs. As an intern, you'll collaborate with a dynamic team in a startup environment and have the chance to learn from some of the most accomplished and experienced aerospace professionals in the industry. We're committed to offering an experience where your decisions and contributions play a pivotal role in driving Muon's success.

Responsibilities

- Take ownership of or contribute to the market research needed to identify key opportunities that are matched with Muon’s capabilities.

- Initiate or assist competitive analysis and assessment of in-country primes, or other external satellite bus manufacturers.

- Recommend key customers and events in country to have Muon leadership attend

Qualifications

- Research skills to include identifying, synthesizing and summarizing open source data and ability to distill country strategy, defense and civil agency budgets

- Excellent communication skills.

- Previous internship or co-op experience

- Previous experience on business or marketing project teams

- Experience with Microsoft (Word, Excel, PowerPoint) or Google suite of products (Docs, Sheets, Slides)

- Experience presenting results to medium size teams.

Muon is built on a vision of a world that sees itself clearly—where real-time planetary insight drives action to protect lives, build resilience, and compound into shared prosperity. To support this mission, Muon seeks a People Operations Manager to join our rapidly growing People Operations team. The ideal candidate is a highly empathetic, high-integrity leader who will serve as the operational bedrock of our employee experience. Reporting to the VP of People Operations, you will lead a dedicated team delivering operational excellence across the employee experience balancing strategic scaling and compliance with a deeply human-centric approach.

This position is hybrid and requires working on-site in our San Jose, CA office three days per week. Could flex to accommodate remote for exceptional candidates who are located in the West Coast timezone and could travel to the Bay Area at least once a quarter.

Responsibilities

- Autonomy & Drive : Proven ability to translate broad business goals into actionable project roadmaps and execute independently with minimal direction.

The mission of the Senior BD Manager is to drive Muon Space’s growth by owning the end-to-end commercial and civil space business capture process, from customer discovery and lead generation through deal qualification and closure. By collaborating with cross-functional engineering and product teams to deliver integrated solutions, this role will accelerate pipeline throughput and ensure the realization of the company’s strategic commercial and civil space objectives across market segments, including remote sensing, commercial satcom, and next-generation orbital infrastructure.

- Lead customer discovery and lead generation activities to identify new opportunities.

- Collaborate across teams, including Mission Engineering and Product, to deliver integrated solutions for customers.

- Manage active pipeline opportunities, facilitating increased deal velocity through cross-functional collaboration with Mission Architecture teams.

- Implement qualification criteria and price estimation frameworks for "standard" deals to reduce friction from pursuit review to ROM pricing.

- Deliver market sizing reports and customer discovery insights for "next generation" verticals.

- Proven track record of managing complex external relationships and working with customers during both pre-sales and execution stages.

About Muon Space

Founded in 2021, Muon Space is an end-to-end Space Systems Provider that designs, builds, and operates LEO satellite constellations delivering mission-critical data. Our revolutionary, integrated technology stack enables customers to optimize every dimension of their missions for faster time-to-orbit and superior constellation remote sensing performance. Our state-of-the-art facility in the heart of Silicon Valley is optimized for manufacturing spacecraft and rapid, flexible payload integration at scale. From climate monitoring to national security, Muon Space is dedicated to delivering Earth Intelligence for a safer and more resilient world.

ITAR/EAR Requirements

This position requires access to export controlled information. To conform to U.S. Government export regulations applicable to that information, applicant must either be (A) a U.S. person, defined as a (i) U.S. citizen or national, (ii) U.S. lawful, permanent resident (green card holder), (iii) refugee under 8 U.S.C. § 1157, or (iv) asylee under 8 U.S.C. § 1158, (B) eligible to access the export controlled information without a required export authorization, or (C) eligible and reasonably likely to obtain the required export authorization from the applicable U.S. government agency. The Company may, for legitimate business reasons, decline to pursue any export licensing process.
